takeaways: The page is a listing of Tuts+ game development tutorials, with short blurbs for each.
It includes Matter.js tutorials (introduction and Body module) for JavaScript physics.
Other listed topics include game design documents, JavaScript game engines, Android and iOS templates, and Unity card generation.
The custom physics engine series named in the listing is not visible in the page text.
summary.summary: This is a category listing page from Envato Tuts+ showing a set of game development tutorials, each with a short description and difficulty level. The visible entries cover Matter.js (introduction and Body module), game design documents, JavaScript game engines, Android and iOS game templates, Unity code-generated playing cards, and shader-based toon water. The page text does not include the "How to Create a Custom Physics Engine" series that the directory listing points to, so this summary reflects only the index page.
